phases.command: node -e 'const {io}=require("socket.io-client");const s=io("http://127.0.0.1:3408",{transports:["websocket"]});const call=(ev,...a)=>new Promise((res)=>s.emit(ev,...a,res));const log=(n,r)=>console.log(n,JSON.stringify(r).slice(0,200));const MON={type:"http",name:"self",parent:null,url:"http://127.0.0.1:3408/api/entry-page",method:"GET",interval:60,retryInterval:60,resendInterval:0,maxretries:0,notificationIDList:{},ignoreTls:false,upsideDown:false,expiryNotification:false,maxredirects:10,accepted_statuscodes:["200-299"],saveResponse:false,saveErrorResponse:true,responseMaxLength:1024,dns_resolve_type:"A",proxyId:null,authMethod:null,httpBodyEncoding:"json",kafkaProducerBrokers:[],kafkaProducerSaslOptions:{mechanism:"None"},rabbitmqNodes:[],conditions:[],active:true};s.on("connect",async()=>{try{log("needSetup",await call("needSetup"));log("setup",await call("setup","admin","kuma-test-1234"));log("login",await call("login",{username:"admin",password:"kuma-test-1234",token:""}));const add=await call("add",MON);log("add",add);const id=add.monitorID;log("getMonitorList",await call("getMonitorList"));log("getMonitor",await call("getMonitor",id));log("getMonitorBeats",await call("getMonitorBeats",id,24));log("getMonitorChartData",await call("getMonitorChartData",id,24));log("getSettings",await call("getSettings"));log("addTag",await call("addTag",{name:"prod",color:"#059669"}));log("getTags",await call("getTags"));log("addStatusPage",await call("addStatusPage","Demo","demo"));log("getStatusPage",await call("getStatusPage","demo"));log("getMaintenanceList",await call("getMaintenanceList"));log("getAPIKeyList",await call("getAPIKeyList"));}catch(e){console.log("ERR",String(e).slice(0,300))}finally{setTimeout(()=>process.exit(0),1500)}});setTimeout(()=>process.exit(0),60000);'
